about: Presets of A's condition questions (plan 56 order 5, policy ②④). period.windows: the recommended windows offered when a question names no period; each quote is read by the period reader on the as_of calendar (policy ①) to give the option's range, and the user may type another period instead. frequency.labels: the option label of each frequency, also the word the period reader reads as that frequency. Nothing here is applied without the user's answer.
